message.reasoning: Okay, so I'm trying to figure out what the right thing to do is in this situation. My coworker has been calling me late at night, and it's really bothering me. I finally lost my temper and screamed at her to stop or else I'll block her number. Now I'm wondering if that was the right approach or not. First, I need to understand why she's calling me late at night. Maybe she's going through something and needs help, or perhaps she doesn't realize the time difference. Instead of addressing the issue calmly, I let my emotions take over. That's not ideal because it can damage our working relationship. It could lead to more misunderstandings and affect our teamwork. Instead, finding a middle ground where both of our needs are respected would be better. In the future, I should work on managing my emotions better. Taking a moment to breathe before responding can help prevent impulsive actions. It's important to communicate clearly and respectfully, even when I'm feeling frustrated. Overall, while I understand why I reacted the way I did, it wasn't the most effective solution. Handling the situation calmly and constructively would have been a better approach to maintain a positive working relationship.
